column3: MT 48:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew; “the remotest parts of Zaphon” is rendered “on the sides of the north.”
Close to the Hebrew; בְּאַרְמְנוֹתֶיהָ (“its citadels”) is rendered “her palaces.”
Close to the Hebrew; רְעָדָה (“trembling”) is rendered “Fear.”
Close to the Hebrew; לְחֵילָה (“its rampart”) is rendered “her bulwarks,” and “its citadels” “her palaces.”
Close to the Hebrew; עַל־ מוּת (“over death”) is rendered “Even to death.”
